description: This Java class 'MacroMenuRenderer' implements the 'MenuStringRenderer' interface to render menu components using FreeMarker templates. It manages macro execution, rendering menu items, links, images, and handling template environments within a web application context, specifically for the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MacroMenuRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for menus that uses FreeMarker macros to generate menu HTML, supporting images, links, and nested menu items within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createImageParameters
methods.description: Constructs a map of parameters for rendering an image, resolving URLs based on the request context.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Executes a macro by including a macro template into the FreeMarker environment.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Overloaded method that constructs a macro invocation string with parameters and executes it.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker environment for macro execution associated with a writer.

methods.name: isDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a menu item should be disabled based on empty context values.

methods.name: isHideIfSelected
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be hidden when it is the selected item.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperClose
methods.description: Placeholder for closing wrapper; no operation.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperOpen
methods.description: Placeholder for opening wrapper; no operation.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Renders all menu items in a menu.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image using a macro with generated parameters.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a link with parameters, handling URL building, confirmation, and modal options.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Renders the closing part of a menu, including optional boundary comments and borders.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders a single menu item, including nested items, with appropriate styles and links.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening part of a menu, including boundary comments and macro invocation.
